> Read protein accessions back into their entry, isoform or version, and applied sequence variants, with mzLib's accession grammars, never repairing one that does not fit.

Wire verb `proteins parse-accession` · Python [`pymzlib.proteins.parse_accessions`][pymzlib.proteins.parse_accessions]

### Wraps

- [`VariantApplication.ParseAccession`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/VariantApplication.cs) in `mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/VariantApplication.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ProteoformAccession`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/ProteoformAccession.cs) in `mzLib/Omics/BioPolymer/ProteoformAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`ProteinAccession.Parse`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs) in `mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`AccessionNamespace`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs) in `mzLib/MzLibUtil/ProteinAccession.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `accessions` | `string[]` | required | — | `>= 1 line` | Read from stdin (not an option): one accession per line, given to mzLib exactly as read, with no trimming, case folding or splitting. Blank lines are skipped. One row per line, in input order, duplicates included. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `record_count` | `int` | accessions | never | Rows: the input accessions. |
| `namespace_counts` | `map<string,int>` | accessions | never | Namespace -> accessions in it; all three keys (unrecognized, uniprot, refseq) always present, zeros included. |
| `with_applied_variants_count` | `int` | accessions | never | Accessions that name applied variants (has_applied_variants true). |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | Column name to one value per input, in input order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Seven static caveats. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `input` | `string` | — | never | The line exactly as read (ProteoformAccession.Verbatim). |
| `entry_accession` | `string` | — | never | The UniProt entry or unversioned RefSeq accession (ProteinAccession.EntryAccession): P04637 for P04637-2_S70N, NP_000537 for NP_000537.3_R72P. Equal to input when unrecognized. Names an entry, not a sequence. |
| `isoform` | `int` | — | yes: no UniProt -n isoform suffix (always null for RefSeq and unrecognized), or a number too large for a 32-bit integer | The UniProt isoform number (ProteinAccession.Isoform). |
| `version` | `int` | — | yes: no RefSeq .n version (always null for UniProt and unrecognized), or a number too large for a 32-bit integer | The RefSeq version (ProteinAccession.Version). |
| `namespace` | `string` | — | never | uniprot, refseq or unrecognized: mzLib's AccessionNamespace, lower case as genes resolve and mzLib's GeneResolutionTsv write it. |
| `parent_accession` | `string` | — | never | The accession of the entry the variants were applied to, as written, isoform or version kept (ProteoformAccession.Entry.Verbatim): P04637-2 for P04637-2_Q5*. Equal to input when there are no applied variants. |
| `applied_variants` | `string` | — | yes: the accession names no applied variant | The variant suffix as written, without the leading '_' (ProteoformAccession.AppliedVariants): S70N, or S70N_A80T for several. |
| `has_applied_variants` | `bool` | — | never | ProteoformAccession.HasAppliedVariants: applied_variants is not null. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | no accessions on stdin |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | never expected: ParseAccession does not throw |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Parses, never repairs (mzLib's rule): an accession outside the UniProt and RefSeq protein grammars is unrecognized and kept verbatim, entry_accession equal to input. That includes lower case, surrounding spaces, a FASTA header (sp\|P04637\|P53_HUMAN), a decoy, contaminant or entrapment prefix (DECOY_P04637), and ProteinDbLoader's collision counter (P04637_2, which names a different entry whose accession collided).
- entry_accession names the entry, not a sequence: P04637 and P04637-2 share it but are different sequences, and the isoform UniProt displays for an entry can carry any number. It answers 'same entry', never 'same sequence'.
- A protein-group accession joined with '\|' (P04637\|P02768) is unrecognized as a whole: mzLib does not split it. Split protein groups first.
- Only RefSeq protein accessions (NP_, XP_, YP_, WP_, AP_) are recognized; a RefSeq transcript (NM_) or an Ensembl id (ENSP...) is unrecognized.
- A variant suffix is read only after an entry mzLib recognizes, in the form mzLib's GetAccession writes: '_', the original residues, a 1-based position, the variant residues (S70N; a deletion A80; a stop gain Q5*), repeated for several (S70N_A80T). applied_variants is that suffix as written: it is not checked against any sequence.
- An isoform or version number too large for a 32-bit integer (over 2147483647) reads as null while the accession still counts as UniProt or RefSeq: mzLib keeps the entry and drops the number.
- Each stdin line is one accession, given to mzLib exactly as read; blank lines are skipped. One row per line, in input order, duplicates included.

### Example

```python
parsed = pymzlib.proteins.parse_accessions(['P04637', 'P04637-2', 'Q13409-2', 'NP_000537.3_R72P', 'P04637_S70N_A80T', 'P04637_2', 'DECOY_P02768', 'sp|P04637|P53_HUMAN', 'P04637|P02768'])
```

### References

- [doi:10.1093/nar/gkae1010](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkae1010): UniProt, whose published accession grammar (and -n isoform suffix) mzLib matches (UniProt Consortium 2025, NAR)
- [doi:10.1093/nar/gkv1189](https://doi.org/10.1093/nar/gkv1189): RefSeq, whose protein accession prefixes and .n versions mzLib matches (O'Leary et al. 2016, NAR)

!!! warning "Not yet verified"

    - Whether to split '\|'-joined protein-group accessions before parsing: mzLib does not, so the verb does not either. Splitting is a grouping rule, and it belongs in mzLib if anywhere.
    - An isoform or version past int.MaxValue is dropped with no signal while the namespace still reads uniprot or refseq (ProteinAccession.NumberOrNull). Whether mzLib should leave such an accession unrecognized instead is an mzLib question, not raised upstream yet.
    - Not yet ported to mzLibRust or mzLibR; the binding names above are proposals.
